zone_description: A candlelit country house where the clocks stopped the night something unforgivable happened, and never started again.
global_theme_rules: Rooms are the halls, chambers, cellars, and attics of Blackthorn Manor. North/south/east/west cross a floor; up/down are the great stair, the servants' stair, and the cellar steps. Gothic and candlelit: dust sheets, stopped clocks, portraits whose subjects share a family jaw. The supernatural is real but bound by house logic — ghosts are npc entities with wants and grievances, and oppressive cold, sourceless dread, or rooms that refuse to open are obstacle entities, released by flags like seance_held or true_name_spoken. Violence solves nothing here; attention and understanding do. Keep it 1890s: oil lamps and letters, no modern devices. The curse lifts — curse_lifted — only when the wrong done in this house is named aloud and set right.

starting_room.description: A high entrance hall where your footsteps wake echoes that take too long to die. A grand staircase climbs into darkness, doorways open east and north beneath unlit sconces, and every piece of furniture wears a dust sheet like a shroud.

entities.name: shrouded portrait
entities.description: A tall portrait under a dust sheet that has slipped at one corner, showing a painted hand wearing a signet ring — and, below the frame, a brass plate someone has deliberately scratched illegible.

starting_inventory.name: tarnished candelabra
starting_inventory.description: A three-branched candelabra with fresh candles, left for you on the hall table as if you were expected.

starting_inventory.name: housekeeper's letter
starting_inventory.description: A letter in a careful, frightened hand: '...none of us will set foot past the gate now. If you truly mean to stay the night, begin in the cellar. It began in the cellar.'

win_message: The name hangs in the air for one long moment — and then every stopped clock in Blackthorn Manor begins to tick at once. Warmth creeps back into the walls, the portraits are only paintings again, and somewhere upstairs a window opens on its own to let the morning in. The house is at peace. You've won.
visual_style: Gothic horror oil painting, candlelit Victorian manor, deep shadows and pale moonlight through mullioned windows, muted browns and cold blues, Pre-Raphaelite atmosphere
